name: Inline Tooltips
author: Benedikt Ledl

sections.description:
Inline Tooltips is a lightweight WordPress plugin to add inline tooltips to the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg). You can add additional context, definitions, or notes to any part of your content without disrupting the reader’s flow.

Features:
– Adds a tooltip button to the Gutenberg text editor inline toolbar.
– Allows users to define custom tooltip text.
– Displays tooltips on hover, providing users with a smooth, seamless reading experience.
– Includes minimal styling that integrates easily with most themes.
sections.faq:
How do I use the tooltip feature?

  1. Open a page or post in the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg).
  2. Highlight text, and click the more button and then the add tooltip button in the toolbar.
  3. Enter the desired tooltip text when prompted.

Can I change the tooltip style?

You can customize tooltip styles by editing the css to suit your theme’s design.
